tooltip.app.title: Infrastructure Health & Benchmark combines configuration checks and performance measurements for the complete viewing path from client to IIS and image storage.
tooltip.app.subtitle: The dashboard separates client network, IIS, storage, configuration and DZI image delivery so the likely limiting segment can be identified quickly.
tooltip.language: Changes only the Infrastructure Health & Benchmark interface language. Windows and browser language are ignored. The choice is saved for this browser profile; English (US) is the default and fallback.
tooltip.quick: Runs the lightweight synthetic smoke test: a small HTTP transfer plus four synthetic DZI tile requests. It is fast, low-impact and does not require the real reference dataset.
tooltip.full: Runs HTTP throughput tests and the selected local reference workload. DZI workloads use OpenSeadragon navigation; file sequences measure payload retrieval.
tooltip.export: Downloads the current diagnostic snapshot as JSON, including server health, configuration checks, browser benchmark results, scores, selected UI language and browser user agent.
tooltip.refresh: Reloads the latest server-health.json from IIS. It does not start a new browser benchmark or a new PowerShell health run.
tooltip.overall.score: Combined diagnostic score from the available Client-to-IIS, IIS-to-storage and image-delivery scores. The weakest segment has the greatest influence. Loopback network tests are excluded.
tooltip.overall.status: Human-readable classification of the overall score: Excellent, Good, Degraded or Poor. It is a diagnostic indicator, not a contractual certification.
tooltip.overall.bottleneck: Shows the lowest-scoring usable segment as the most likely performance bottleneck. If no segment is clearly poor, no major bottleneck is reported.
tooltip.topology: Visualizes the actual data path measured by Infrastructure Health & Benchmark: this client, the Application IIS server and the physical storage behind /App/images.
tooltip.topology.client: The browser or Application viewing station from which this diagnostics page is opened.
tooltip.topology.clientLink: Client-to-IIS HTTP path. After a test this link shows measured throughput and TTFB, or indicates that localhost bypasses the physical network.
tooltip.topology.server: The IIS server hosting the /App application and serving image requests to the client.
tooltip.topology.storageLink: IIS-to-storage path. It summarizes benchmark-file open latency and, for UNC storage, the negotiated SMB dialect when Windows can report it.
tooltip.topology.storage: The image storage used by the IIS /App/images virtual directory. This can be a local folder or a UNC/SMB share.
tooltip.topology.storagePath: The physical path currently configured behind the IIS /App/images virtual directory. This is the path used for the end-to-end tile test.
tooltip.clientIis: Measures the HTTP path from this browser to IIS. On localhost the physical LAN is bypassed, so the network score is intentionally N/A.
tooltip.loopback: This page was opened through localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1. HTTP timings are still shown, but they do not represent the physical client network and are excluded from the network score.
tooltip.ttfb: TTFB means Time To First Byte. It is the time from starting the HTTP request until the response begins to arrive. Lower values are better and mainly reflect latency plus server response time.
tooltip.throughput: Effective rate of one HTTP download from IIS to this browser. Higher values are better. On localhost this is loopback performance, not physical NIC throughput.
tooltip.parallelThroughput: Aggregate rate of four simultaneous 16 MiB HTTP downloads. It is measured by the Full Benchmark and helps reveal whether multiple concurrent requests use available bandwidth efficiently.
tooltip.networkScore: Diagnostic score for the Client-to-IIS path, based on TTFB and single-stream throughput. It is not calculated for localhost/loopback tests.
tooltip.iisServer: Snapshot of the Windows/IIS host that serves Application. These values help distinguish server resource pressure from network or storage problems.
tooltip.iisState: Current state of the configured IIS site. Started means IIS is available to serve Application requests.
tooltip.cpu: Current processor load captured by the PowerShell health worker. It is a point-in-time value, so short spikes may change between updates.
tooltip.memory: Percentage of physical RAM currently in use on the IIS server. Very high sustained usage can contribute to paging and slower response times.
tooltip.nic: Highest link speed reported by an enabled Windows network adapter on the IIS server. This is adapter metadata, not measured application throughput.
tooltip.healthTaskContext: Windows account under which the Infrastructure Health & Benchmark scheduled task runs. This identity is also used for storage access and Windows Integrated SQL diagnostics.
tooltip.iisStorage: Measures the server-side path from IIS to the image storage. This segment is especially sensitive to SMB latency, file-open latency and storage performance.
tooltip.availability: Whether the PowerShell health worker can currently access the physical path configured for IIS /App/images.
tooltip.directoryLatency: Time required to enumerate up to the first 10 entries in the image-storage directory. Lower is better; high values can indicate SMB, metadata or storage latency.
tooltip.fileOpenLatency: Time required to open the benchmark file for sequential reading before any file content is read. Deep Zoom workloads can be very sensitive to slow file opens.
tooltip.quickSampleRead: Lightweight server-side read of 1 MiB by default. It is informational only and is not used as a storage-throughput score because such a small sample is strongly affected by open and protocol overhead.
tooltip.fullSampleRead: Server-side sequential read of 64 MiB by default when the PowerShell health engine is run with -Full. This larger sample is included in the storage score.
tooltip.smbDialect: SMB protocol dialect negotiated by Windows for UNC storage. Modern SMB 2/3 is preferred; legacy values such as 1.5 indicate an old SMB 1.x connection. Local paths may show N/A.
tooltip.storageScore: Diagnostic score for IIS-to-storage. Availability, directory latency and file-open latency are always considered; full read throughput is added only when a server-side Full sample is available.
tooltip.imageDelivery: Measures real HTTP delivery of synthetic Deep Zoom tiles through /App/images, so the path includes the browser, IIS and the configured image storage.
tooltip.tileP50: Median tile completion time. P50 means 50% of measured tile requests completed in this time or faster. Lower is better.
tooltip.tileP95: 95th-percentile tile completion time. P95 means 95% of tile requests completed in this time or faster. It highlights slow outliers and stalls better than the average.
tooltip.tileFailures: Number of synthetic DZI tile HTTP requests that failed. A value above zero can indicate IIS, storage, authentication, path or network problems.
tooltip.viewportLoad: Elapsed wall-clock time for the synthetic tile request batch to complete. It approximates how quickly a Deep Zoom viewport can be populated; the OpenSeadragon open time is logged separately.
tooltip.imageScore: Diagnostic score for image/tile delivery, primarily based on tile P95 latency and request failures. It reflects the user-visible Deep Zoom path more directly than raw storage speed alone.
tooltip.config: Compares independent Application configuration sources to detect systems that are internally inconsistent even when each individual component is reachable.
tooltip.config.status: PASS means all required configuration sources are available and consistent. WARNING means one or more sources are unavailable, disagree, or the DZI framework check is incomplete.
tooltip.config.registry: Optional image path from the registry key configured in the local Diagnostics settings.
tooltip.config.sql64: Checks SQL connectivity through the configured 64-bit System DSN using Windows integrated authentication. An optional local query can return the image path.
tooltip.config.sql32: Checks SQL connectivity through the configured 32-bit System DSN using Windows integrated authentication. An optional local query can return the image path.
tooltip.config.iis: Actual physical path served by the IIS /App/images virtual directory. This is the path the browser uses for image delivery.
tooltip.config.message: Summarizes whether Registry, SQL 64-bit, SQL 32-bit and IIS agree on the Application image path and whether the required configuration sensors are available.
tooltip.config.details: Additional diagnostic metadata such as DSN driver/target, Windows authentication context, detected DZI framework/components and the Health preview engine.
tooltip.preview: Visual area for the selected benchmark workload. Real XY Mosaic/Volume Full Benchmark templates are driven by Infrastructure Health & Benchmark's pinned OpenSeadragon runtime; Quick Test stays synthetic and independent.
tooltip.preview.viewer: Interactive synthetic Deep Zoom preview loaded through the same /App/images path used by the tile benchmark. Pan and zoom exercise repeated tile requests through IIS and storage.
tooltip.preview.note: Explains the relationship between the independent raw tile benchmark, the Application product DZI framework and the separate bundled Health preview engine.
tooltip.log: Timestamped browser-side diagnostic events for the current page session, including health refreshes, benchmark runs, warnings and OpenSeadragon preview events.
tooltip.runStatus: Current state of the browser-side diagnostics, for example Ready, Running Quick Test, Running Full Benchmark or Failed.
tooltip.logEntries: Detailed event log for this browser session. It is useful when a test fails or when the order and timing of diagnostic steps needs to be reviewed.
tooltip.timestamp: Timestamp contained in the latest server-health.json snapshot. The scheduled PowerShell task updates this server-side data independently from browser benchmarks.
tooltip.footerProduct: Installed dashboard version. Include this version when reporting a Infrastructure Health & Benchmark issue so Support can identify the exact diagnostic build.
tooltip.footerDisclaimer: The measurements are troubleshooting indicators and are not a contractual certification of LAN, storage or server performance.

tooltip.requestP50: Median completion time of the real image/file requests in the selected workload. P50 means 50% completed in this time or faster.

tooltip.requestFailures: Number of real reference image/file HTTP requests that failed during the selected workload.
